title: REQ · GameLayout gives about 3/4 width to the game area and drops to a store-driven bottom drawer when narrow
summary: Change desktop split from 4fr/1fr to 3fr/1fr, keep the md drawer behaviour
description: Context: GameLayout.tsx L19 uses md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr]. Desired: 3fr/1fr so the panel gets a quarter, holding from 1280x720 up; below md the aside is a fixed bottom drawer driven by useUiStore.drawerOpen (already implemented). Expected: classes updated. Why: matches the reference.
acceptance_criteria: Given the root grid, when rendered, then it has class md:grid-cols-[3fr_1fr] and not md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr]
Given the aside, when rendered, then it keeps max-md fixed bottom drawer classes and data-state from drawerOpen
definition_of_done: Grid class changed; narrow drawer unchanged
